The other two slices of the same selector (R-185-API, R-185-BR2) and R-P0 / R-CUST are separate records. Labels: `qa-run` only.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: objectstack-ai/objectstack `main` @ `a557fa386bc3` (2026-11-15 09:05Z), 323 first-parent commits past 18.4.0 (`181ad7d4`). Console under `/_console` built in the same tree from `ui/` with `pnpm console:build` at 09:53Z, so every `ui/` change in the range was live.
- Build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (18 s); closure `turbo build --filter=@objectstack/example-showcase... --filter=@objectstack/cli... --filter=@objectstack/dogfood...` with `OS_SKIP_DTS` unset, 70 packages, 6m44s; `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` 6m21s; `pnpm build --concurrency=2` for the 9 remaining packages, 40 s (`check-dev-prereqs` green: 107/107).
- App: `examples/app-showcase`, booted per item with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch`, own port (41200–41244, 5 per runner group) and own file DB under `/tmp/qa3br1/‹group›/`, `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported. Self-pinging connectors, package installs/exports/upgrades, the external datasource, jobs and email declared-source reloads ran on scratch app copies compiled under their own `OS_PORT` with a private `OS_HOME`; the tree's `installed-packages/` ledger stayed absent and `dist/objectstack.json` unchanged throughout. Walled legs on `qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot` (group / isolated). Scheduled-work legs with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`. Local fixtures: fake SMTP sink (plugin-email testkit), a webhook receiver, a mock OIDC IdP / discovery stub, a local verdaccio for the scaffold item.
- Runner: one Claude Code cloud session (BR1 runner thread for qa#3), 9 runner subagents (effort high, at most 3 at a time), Playwright chromium (sign-in through the console form, identity proven by `GET /auth/get-session` per persona). vitest `--maxWorkers=1`, one package per invocation, dogfood one file per invocation. Node 22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0.
- Timestamps: setup 09:39–09:55Z; tests 09:55–12:17Z (groups A–C 09:55–10:48, D 10:39–11:29, E 10:46–11:25, F 10:48–11:29, G 11:25–12:15, H 11:29–12:17, I 11:29–12:08). Setup : test wall-clock ≈ 16 min : 142 min.

## FAIL rows, reproduction rules and dispositions

### identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session · rev 2 · FAIL (3/5)

- **acceptance[2] · fail · product defect (low) → card `card-185-BR1-3`.** Repro: sign in as admin through the console form, open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/‹id›`; from a second client signed in as the same admin `POST /api/v1/auth/revoke-other-sessions {}` → 200; in the tab click the sidebar link "Projects" (no reload). Expected one `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` re-check (`ui/packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx:295-300`, "A burst of 401s from one navigation collapses to one read"); actual two get-session reads, both 401, ~10 ms apart, then the tab lands on `/_console/login?redirect=%2Fapps%2Fcom.example.showcase%2Fshowcase_project` (end state correct). Reproduced 3× in fresh contexts. Mechanism: the in-flight flag is cleared in `finally` before React commits `setUser(null)` (`AuthProvider.tsx:308-322`). Not a regression: the session-end path is unchanged since `181ad7d4`.
- **acceptance[0] · fail · assertion defect → test-fix card `card-185-BR1-4`.** Repro: sign in as admin via the form, set a probe key in both stores, Account menu → Log out, read `Object.keys(localStorage)` on `/_console/login`. Expected only `auth-session-token, auth-session-user-id, vite-ui-theme, objectui-locale, objectui-locale-seed`; actual adds `flow-palette-recents="[]"`, which the anonymous shell writes itself (`FlowPaletteRecentsProvider.tsx:165-181`; a never-signed-in `/login` visit writes the same key). Every key the session wrote is gone, so the product is right and the clause's kept-key list needs that key.

### platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal · rev 5 · FAIL (5/7)

- **acceptance[0] and acceptance[3] · fail · stale spec → re-point card `card-185-BR1-5`.** Repro (scratch showcase copy, private `OS_HOME`): two `defineStack` packages `com.qa.addr-a` (ns `qa_a`) and `com.qa.addr-b` (ns `qa_b`), each declaring `connectors: [{ name: 'qa_conn', type: 'api', enabled: false }]`; `os package install` a then b → expected 422 `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` naming `qa_conn`; actual both install, `/meta/connector` lists `qa_conn` under each package, bare `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/qa_conn` → 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. A cold boot of `composeStacks([d, c], { manifest: 'preserve' })` of the same pair logs no "Bare-name conflict at boot" line (expected one). Cause: #33431 (`322ded7da`, after 18.4.0) narrowed `connector` per namespace by design; it was the last type outside `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts:160-178`), so the clause has no type left to drive. A namespace-less co-owner still gets the 422 (probe). Not a product regression.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 87 minutes in total across the nine groups (A ~11, B ~7, C ~10, D ~8, E ~9, F ~12, G ~10, H ~10, I ~10), each on the items' own boots after their clauses had verdicts, as admin, plain contributor members, external members, item personas and anonymous clients. Boundary classes: empty / whitespace / unknown ids, empty and malformed bodies, unknown packages and namespaces, inverted windows, self-delegation, case-folded emails, CRLF header injection on the raw email door. Opposite postures: group and isolated beside single, demote beside promote, enable beside disable, namespace-less beside namespaced holders. Readers outside scope: third members on notifications, inbox receipts, approval comments and reassigns, invitations addressed to others, other users' API keys and preferences. Findings: card-185-BR1-1 and card-185-BR1-2 (product defects), two duplicates of open cards (#33099, #33507), one security-class observation reported privately to the PM (withheld row above); everything else held. Per-door detail is at the end of each clause file.
